items.html: It turns out accordingly that three Nekudot take illumination for the need of their vessels from the three lights, which are AHP, precisely at the Shibolet. But the seven lower ones take only from two lights alone, which are Hotem and Peh, from the Shibolet downward to the Tabur; for the light of the upper Ozen was already completed and sealed at the Shibolet of the beard. Therefore the illumination of the three upper Nekudot is greater than that of the seven lower ones.
